{{Top|leg}}
'''Carfoom''' was a location. One week after graduating from the Space Academy on [[Raithal/Legends|Raithal]], [[Jann Tosh]] was posted to an outpost on Carfoom. During his first [[Standard week/Legends|week]] there, he was shot in the back, and paralyzed from the waist down.<ref name="Part 2">{{SW|url=news/the-droids-re-animated-part-2|serieslink=The Droids Re-Animated|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Carfoom was mentioned in the article " The Droids Re-Animated: Part 2". The article did not mention if Carfoom was a planet, moon, settlement, or another kind of location, so it is unclear what kind of location Carfoom is.<ref name="Part 2" />
